visualCharacteristics: New variant (no existing variants in project): Image/text teaser rows with large circular images, alternating sides | White page background (visual tree rc3, colored:false). Contains 3 pale-blue text cards with outlined CTA buttons, then 3 alternating image/text teasers with circular images, then 'Related insights' H2 and 3 article cards (image, date, read time, H4 title, author, tag pill).

contentPattern.reason: Each teaser is a fixed image + text pair side by side that never wraps into a grid; one Columns block with 3 rows, cell order keeps the left/right alternation. The bold fund name stays a strong paragraph, not a heading.

structure.rows: One row per teaser, same number of cells in every row

usage: Stacked image/text teaser rows with large circular images. One row per teaser, two cells each; put the image in the first or second cell to choose its side, so rows can alternate. Text cell: optional H2, bold fund name paragraph, description, CTA link.
reuseGuidance: Use for alternating image/text fund or product teasers. For generic multi-column layouts use columns.
